about: A fourth synthetic person, held out (spec 055): ten sessions, then a fresh session with no hints. It holds what spec 055 names: two abstention probes, a planned change against the current value, a closure trap (an event that looks like done and is not) and a list the person asked to keep. Frozen on 2026-10-19, after spec 055 was implemented and before any run on it. Nothing here is a real person.

messages: Hi! I'm Ines, 37, an architect at a small studio in Porto.
My husband Marco is a chef.
Our son Tiago is 6 and just started swimming lessons.
Can you suggest a name for a small architecture newsletter?
I go rock climbing on Tuesday evenings at a gym near the river.
I'm training for a bouldering competition on May 16.
How should I warm up before climbing?
Thanks.
Please always give temperatures in Celsius.
And I'm allergic to shellfish.
What can I cook for a quick dinner?
Great.
Can you keep a list of books I want to read? Pachinko, The Overstory and Klara and the Sun.
I promised my sister Rita I'd send her the photos from her wedding by the end of March.
What's a good way to organise lots of photos?
Correction: Tiago is 7, not 6, his birthday was in January.
From now on please don't use emojis in your answers.
Ideas for a 7-year-old's weekend?
I picked the best 50 wedding photos for Rita, I still need to edit them before sending.
Add Piranesi to my reading list.
Which free photo editors are good?
Big news: our studio is moving to Lisbon, and I'll work from the Lisbon office from September 1.
We'll keep living in Porto for now, I'll commute twice a week.
How long is the train from Porto to Lisbon?
One more preference: start every answer with a one-line summary.
The climbing gym changed its schedule, so I climb on Friday evenings now.
Any tips for climbing on tired days?
The competition was on Saturday, I came third!
Marco opened his own restaurant last week, it's called Maré.
How can I help promote a new restaurant?
I need to renew Tiago's passport before our trip in August.
Tiago swims twice a week now.
Any good stretches for climbers?
